decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed single storey side extension and extension to the rear roof slope would not harm neighbours' living conditions or the appearance of the area. The development complies with Adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area and building in particular and to satisfy the requirements of policies ENV B1.1New Development and H6.4 Extensions and alterations)

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  To protect the amenity and privacy of nearby residents  in accordance with policy ENV.B.1.1 New development)

Condition : 6 - The outbuilding, the closest to the approved ground floor extension, as shown on the e-mail received 21/03/05, shall be demolished prior to the commencement of the approved works.

(Reason.   In the interests of the appearance of the area and to safeguard neighbouring residents' living conditions.)
description: Erection of single storey side extension to the existing rear extension and rear roof extension to house.
